diagnostics.sppr_budget_note: Weighted export check is method-specific; physical biomass budgets are assessed independently. Natural fate exports are reported separately.

warnings: 2 group(s) route less than 100% of their flow_to_det to detritus; the remainder is treated as export out of the system: 68 (Phytoplankton), 66 (Zooplankton).

4 group(s) have TE=0 because EE=0 (M0=p): 52 (Introduced species), 48 (Migratory waders), 29 (Other seabirds), 24 (Pipefishes). Their consumed PP is re-credited to detritus (fix_EE_0_cases=True) so the TE SPPR stays PP-balanced.

8 group(s) have near-zero TE (0 < EE << 1): 30 (Rays), 9 (Gulls and Terns), 8 (Australian Pelican), 6 (Cormorants), 5 (Tailors), 4 (Bottlenose Dolphin), 2 (Barracudas), 1 (Large sharks). Their SPPR is near-singular (inherent to the TE method); the detritus SPPR may be inflated and is not corrected by fix_EE_0_cases.
